run_policy.protocol: Present each prompt as a Skill-selection task using only the named coexistence catalog. Require every selected Skill to be opened so loading is observable; do not solve the underlying task.
run_policy.repetition_rule: Run each case once, then repeat only when variation, an unexpected result, or failure impact could change the decision.
run_policy.verdict_rule: Record pass, fail, unstable, not exposed, or not executed per case. Mixed observations are unstable.

cases.prompt: Format this Markdown document for consistent blank lines, lists, code fences, and links without changing its wording.
Normalize this file against the format-markdown CommonMark workflow and show the resulting diff.
Rewrite this Japanese technical explanation for clarity, paragraph flow, terminology consistency, and concision.
Review this documentation diff for factual accuracy, compatibility problems, missing verification, and misleading claims.
The documentation wording and structure are approved. Implement the specified Markdown and configuration edits and run the agreed checks.
Design a repository-wide Markdown lint and formatting toolchain, including dependencies, configuration, CI scope, risks, and verification.
Run the repository's configured formatter on the changed Go source files.
In this Japanese paragraph, insert half-width spaces where Japanese text touches English words, while preserving URLs and identifiers.
